Step-Up SIP: ₹2.07 crore vs ₹1.19 crore 📈 | Power of Compounding

Start with ₹25,000/month for 15 years.
Flat SIP: ₹45 lakh invested → ₹1.19 crore
Increase it 10% every year: ₹95.3 lakh invested → ₹2.07 crore

Raise your SIP when your salary rises. It rarely feels like a sacrifice, and it can transform the result.
